mapper.select: SELECT b.seckill_id AS seckillId, b.seckill_name AS seckillName, DATE_FORMAT(b.seckill_end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS seckillEndTime, b.seckill_hour AS seckillHour FROM hou_addon_activity_seckill_base b WHERE b.seckill_state = 1 AND b.seckill_start_time <= NOW() AND b.seckill_end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY b.seckill_hour ASC, b.seckill_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT g.goods_id AS goodsId, g.common_id AS commonId, g.goods_name AS goodsName, g.goods_image AS goodsImage, g.goods_price AS goodsPrice, g.seckill_price AS seckillPrice, IFNULL(c.common_salenum, 0) AS commonSalenum FROM hou_addon_activity_seckill_goods g LEFT JOIN hou_goods_common c ON c.common_id = g.common_id WHERE g.seckill_id = #{seckillId} AND g.seckill_goods_state = 1 ORDER BY g.seckill_goods_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.pintuan_id AS pintuanId, p.common_id AS commonId, p.person_num AS personNum, p.name AS pintuanName, IFNULL(c.common_name, '') AS commonName, IFNULL(c.common_image, '') AS commonImage, IFNULL(c.common_price, 0) AS commonPrice FROM hou_addon_activity_piecing_together p LEFT JOIN hou_goods_common c ON c.common_id = p.common_id WHERE p.status = 1 AND p.start_time <= NOW() AND p.end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY p.display_order ASC, p.pintuan_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.common_id AS commonId, c.common_name AS commonName, c.common_image AS commonImage, c.common_price AS commonPrice, c.common_market_price AS commonMarketPrice, IFNULL(c.common_salenum, 0) AS commonSalenum, c.shop_id AS shopId, c.shop_name AS shopName, c.cat_id AS catId, c.cat_name AS catName FROM hou_goods_common c WHERE c.common_state = 1 AND c.common_verify = 1 ORDER BY c.common_salenum DESC, c.common_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
